zones.label: Command line (developer machine or Vercel build)

groups.label: Sign-in and sessions
groups.description: Signs barnacle.ai staff in with Google (or the fake login), keeps their session cookie and checks it on every page.

groups.label: Signed-in app and user admin
groups.description: Draws the signed-in pages and lets admins add users, change roles and deactivate accounts.

groups.label: Database
groups.description: The Postgres tables every part reads and writes: users, sessions, the user change log and applied migrations.

groups.label: Database commands
groups.description: Command-line tools that apply SQL migrations and load fake data into Postgres.

groups.label: Settings
groups.description: Environment variables (.env.local or Vercel settings) that hold secrets and switch features on or off.

groups.label: People and organisations
groups.description: Staff list, search, create, edit, archive and delete people and organisations, with a timeline and shared lead sources and labels.

groups.label: Deals
groups.description: Pipelines, stages and the deal board, with deals kept private by their person.

groups.label: Deals database
groups.description: The Postgres tables for pipelines, stages, deals, their stage time, labels, linked people and followers.

groups.label: Files
groups.description: Adds, lists, downloads and deletes files on people, organisations and deals, kept in Supabase Storage.

groups.label: Pipedrive import
groups.description: Connects a Pipedrive token and imports people, organisations and deals page by page, never twice.

groups.label: Unsubscribe
groups.description: Lets an email recipient withdraw consent through a token link or RFC 8058 one-click.

groups.label: Segments
groups.description: Saved, team-shared people segments and the count of people each one reaches.

processes.label: Fake Google login (dev and test only)
